column2: Course Objectives: Provide foundational knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Azure AI services, preparing students for the Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) certification exam.

column3: In details, after completing the course, trainees will:
1. Fundamental AI Concepts & Azure AI Overview

column4: - Define and distinguish AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning
- Understand AI workload types: Computer Vision, NLP, Conversational AI, Generative AI
- Identify real-world AI applications in enterprise
- Distinguish Azure AI Services categories and use cases
- Deploy and manage AI services on Azure
- Distinguish Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning
- Understand ML lifecycle: Data → Training → Evaluation → Deployment
- Apply model evaluation metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, RMSE, R²

column3: 3. Computer Vision, NLP, Generative AI Workloads

column4: - Define and distinguish Computer Vision, NLP workloads
- Choose appropriate solutions for real-world problems
- Implement Computer Vision tasks using Azure Vision Services
- Implement NLP tasks using Azure Language Services
- Apply Microsoft's 6 Responsible AI principles in projects
- Use Azure tools for fairness, interpretability, transparency
- Identify and mitigate bias in AI models
- Ensure privacy, security, and accountability in AI solutions

column3: Understand fundamental AI concepts (K1AI): Demonstrate the ability to explain core Artificial Intelligence concepts, key terminologies, major application areas, and the role of AI in digital transformation initiatives.

Understand fundamental Machine Learning concepts (K2AI): Demonstrate the ability to explain essential Machine Learning paradigms, learning workflows, data requirements, and commonly used evaluation metrics.
Understand Azure AI services and capabilities (K3AI): Identify and describe core Azure AI services, their primary functions, and typical enterprise use cases.
Select appropriate Machine Learning approaches (H1AI): Analyze problem statements and select suitable Machine Learning models aligned with business and technical requirements.
Select appropriate Azure AI services (H2AI): Evaluate AI scenarios and recommend appropriate Azure AI services to design effective and scalable solutions.
Make informed AI solution decisions (H3AI): Assess real-world situations and justify the selection of Azure AI services based on constraints, risks, and expected outcomes.
Apply Responsible AI principles (H4AI): Integrate Responsible AI principles (fairness, reliability, security, privacy, transparency, accountability) into the design and deployment of AI solutions.
Achieve AI-900 certification readiness (H5AI): Demonstrate readiness to sit for and successfully obtain the Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) certification.
